brands.description: The Print Shop is a basic desktop publishing software package developed in the early 1980s by Brøderbund. It was unique in that it provided libraries of clip-art and templates through a simple interface to build signs, posters and banners with household dot-matrix printers. Over the years the software has been updated to accommodate changing file formats and printer technologies.

transcript.text: Welcome to Onprint Shop This video highlights the latest enhancements made to the private store features in Onprint Shop.
These updates are focused on improving store level access control and providing secure, convenient login options for B to B customers.
Let's walk through each update step by step.
A new enhancement allows admins to restrict user registrations based on approved e-mail domains at the store level.
With this set up, only customers who have e-mail addresses from specific domains will be able to register and access their respective stores, improving security and access control.
In the Add or Edit Store screen, the admin can enter one or more allowed e-mail domains separated by commas on the storefront.
The new customers with these approved e-mail domains will be allowed to register for that particular store.
The existing customers will be able to log in using their login credentials as previously.
Another update enables customers to login without using a password by simply entering an OTP one time password sent to their e-mail.
This works only if the Enable e-mail OTP login setting is turned on and the allowed e-mail domains are already configured in this flow.
Existing customers can login using their registered e-mail and OTP.
New customers can register by entering an e-mail address from an allowed domain and once validated, they can proceed to add their first and last names and the OTP receiver via e-mail.
If someone tries to log in or register using an e-mail address that doesn't match the approved domains, the system will show a warning message about the invalid e-mail.
We've also added a new store level 2FA2 factor authentication method using e-mail based OTP for B2B store customers.
This gives an extra layer of security by allowing users to log in using a one time password sent to their registered e-mail address in the admin panel while adding or editing a store.
The admin will now have a new e-mail option along with the authenticator method.
To enable this new method, the admin should select the e-mail option and save the changes on the storefront.
Customers will then be able to log in simply by entering their registered e-mail address and the OTP they receive.
Please note that e-mail OTP login and the e-mail base two FA method cannot be used together for the same store.
These improvements give store admins greater control over user access and offer B2B customers a more secure and flexible way to login.
Make sure to explore these options in your store settings to make the most of these features.
Thank you for watching.
We hope these updates bring greater flexibility and efficiency to your B2B customer process.
If you have any questions, our support executives are here to help.
Just reach out through live chat on onprintshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
